function t(name: string, f: () => unknown): void {
  try {
    console.log(name, f());
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof Error) console.log(name, e.name + ": " + e.message);
  }
}
const vals: unknown[] = [3n, -(2n ** 66n), 2, "s", null, undefined, true];
for (const a of vals) {
  if (typeof a !== "bigint") continue;
  for (const b of vals) {
    t("op", () => {
      if (typeof b === "bigint") return [a + b, a - b, a * b, a / b, a % b, a ** 2n, -a, a < b, a >= b, a === b].join(" ");
      if (typeof b === "number") return [a < b, a > b, a <= b, a >= b].join(" ");
      if (typeof b === "string") return a + b;
      return typeof b;
    });
  }
}
const x: any = 7n;
const y: any = 2;
t("anyMix", () => x * y);
t("anyMix2", () => x + y);
t("anyStr", () => x + "!");
t("anyDiv0", () => x / (x - x));
console.log("anyNeg", -x, x - 1n, x * x);
t("anyPlus", () => +x);
t("anyCmp", () => [x > y, x < 7.5, x <= NaN, x >= true]);
t("anyEq", () => [x === 7n, x === 7, x !== 7n]);
